coordinator_fixes.reason: Round 2 coordinator repairs, commit dc32876966, reviewed by GPT-6 Astra. Canonical-raid class rotations: Demonology native range, Fel Flame and no Drain Life; no Fan of Knives for Assassination (user decision); Fire Combustion patience; Elemental Mastery. Shared runtime: no in-place revive for a dead passenger on a static instance transport during an encounter; per-lifecycle native death counts; floorless passenger range recovery refused; LandInLiquid. Scoreboard and fidelity: encounter-scoped death basis, per-attempt Chimaeron Mortality exemption (user decision), enrage-anchored melee fidelity, watchdog reset on a confirmed kill. Composition: warlock declares Fel Flame; DVC reproduced and pushed.
